title: zcbor Kconfig loop: twister + ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=lichen fails on Attic 4.1.0 workspace
description: west twister -p qemu_x86/atom -T <repo>/lichen/tests/checkin_resource -x ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=<repo>/lichen fails at Kconfig parse with a ZCBOR dependency loop (modules/zcbor/Kconfig, imply-related dependencies) in the shared Attic Zephyr v4.1.0 workspace. Baseline-proven 2026-08-28: identical failure with the checkin.c/checkin_resource.c/Kconfig/CMakeLists wave changes stashed; the imply ZCBOR lines (coap/Kconfig:98,163,220,290) are committed code. This matches the documented 4.1.0-vs-v3.7.0 split failure mode in AGENTS.md; repair of the v3.7.0 west tree is project-LICHEN-worker6-xplt. Without the module flag the same twister suite configures, builds, and passes 8/8 (the test is self-contained via target_compile_definitions), so the suite remains verifiable locally. Impact: any twister run that registers the lichen module against the 4.1.0 workspace cannot configure, regardless of branch state.
